# External Demo Submissions

## Purpose

Reserve a location for a possible future, reviewed external-submission capability.

## Scope and Ownership Boundary

External intake is inactive. The studio does not accept submissions, publish a form, create submission accounts, or create contributor contracts in this phase. No active external-submission folders or records are present.

## Authoritative Metadata

If external intake is approved in a future phase, its records must use the reviewed schema in `catalog/metadata/demos.yaml` and preserve submitter assertions separately from verified rights decisions.

## Lifecycle and Asset Distinctions

Any future external demo must follow the same governed lifecycle as other demos. A demo remains distinct from a work, recording, master, or release, and must preserve provenance and lineage.

## Known Limitations and Future Considerations

Before activation, define submission terms, rights and source-material review, privacy and retention, conflict handling, contributor communication, licensing, security, and contract requirements. No external submissions are accepted now.
